    \<comment> \<open>High level types\<close>
    UnsignedInteger
  | Integer
  | Real
  | Boolean<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype textual =
    \<comment> \<open>High level types\<close>
    Character
  | String
    \<comment> \<open>C-specific types\<close>
  | char<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype primitive =
    Numerical number
  | Textual textual<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype array =
    SizedArray primitive
  | TerminatedArray primitive<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype param_type =
    Primitive primitive
  | Array array
  | CType string<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype param_direction =
    InParameter (* also covers 'refin' *)
  | OutParameter
  | InOutParameter<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record parameter =
  p_type        :: param_type
  p_direction   :: param_direction
  p_name        :: idl_symbol<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record "method" =
  m_return_type :: "param_type option"
  m_name        :: idl_symbol
  m_parameters  :: "parameter list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>value(*>*)
  "\<lparr>m_return_type = Some (Primitive (Numerical Integer)),
    m_name = ''foo'',
    m_parameters = [
      \<lparr>p_type = Primitive (Textual String),
       p_direction = InParameter,
       p_name = ''s''\<rparr>
    ]\<rparr>"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{subsec:interfaces}Interfaces\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym procedure = "method list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym event     = nat \<comment> \<open>ID\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym dataport  = "string option" \<comment> \<open>type\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype interface =
    Procedure procedure
  | Event event
  | Dataport dataport<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{subsec:connectors}Connectors\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype connector_type =
    NativeConnector
  | HardwareConnector
  | ExportConnector<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype connector_interface =
    RPCInterface
  | EventInterface
  | DataportInterface<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record connector_access =
    \<comment> \<open>@{text access_foo_bar} means access from the "@{text foo}" label to
        the "@{text bar}" label; labels may be from-components,
        to-components, or the connection itself\<close>
    access_from_to :: "auth set"
    access_to_from :: "auth set"

    \<comment> \<open>It might seem that components on the same side of a connection
        should not need access rights to each other.
        However, these auths are needed in more complicated systems,
        to work around bugs like VER-1108 and to express non-standard
        connector semantics such as VirtQueues.\<close>
    access_from_from :: "auth set"
    access_to_to :: "auth set"

    \<comment> \<open>we assume connections are passive labels, so they do not
        need access rights of their own\<close>
    access_from_conn :: "auth set"
    access_to_conn :: "auth set"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record connector =
    connector_type :: connector_type
    connector_interface :: connector_interface
    connector_access :: connector_access<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{subsec:components}Components\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype InterfaceRequired = InterfaceRequired | InterfaceOptional<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record component =
  control     :: bool
  hardware    :: bool
  requires    :: "(adl_symbol \<times> (InterfaceRequired \<times> procedure)) list"
  provides    :: "(adl_symbol \<times> procedure) list"
  dataports   :: "(adl_symbol \<times> dataport) list"
  emits       :: "(adl_symbol \<times> event) list"
  consumes    :: "(adl_symbol \<times> (InterfaceRequired \<times> event)) list"
  attributes  :: "(adl_symbol \<times> param_type) list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{subsec:assembling}Assembling a System\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record connection =
  conn_type   :: connector
  conn_from   :: "(adl_symbol \<times> adl_symbol) list"
  conn_to     :: "(adl_symbol \<times> adl_symbol) list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record composition =
  components  :: "(adl_symbol \<times> component) list"
  connections :: "(adl_symbol \<times> connection) list"
  group_labels :: "(adl_symbol \<times> adl_symbol) list" \<comment> \<open>See @{text get_group_label}, below\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  get_group_label :: "composition \<Rightarrow> adl_symbol \<Rightarrow> adl_symbol"
where
  "get_group_label spec c \<equiv>
     case map_of (group_labels spec) c of
         Some c' \<Rightarrow> c'
       | None \<Rightarrow> c"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym configuration =
  "(adl_symbol \<times> adl_symbol \<times> string) list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record assembly =
  composition   :: "composition"
  configuration :: "configuration option"
  \<comment> \<open>This lets us shove extra policy edges into the generated integrity policy\<close>
  policy_extra  :: "(adl_symbol \<times> auth \<times> adl_symbol) set"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{subsec:future}Future Work\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{subsubsec:composites}Component Hierarchy\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{subsubsec:iarrays}Interface Arrays\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
